digest.component_or_area: LLM eval framework and rubric vocabulary
propositions: Eval specs contain criterion prompt text phrased in dual vocabulary (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria headings) that no longer exists after vocab collapse.
eval_solver.py generates fixture descriptions with both '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Success Criteria' blocks carrying identical text, reintroducing the removed heading.
Gold-set expectation strings reference 'success criteria' language that must be updated to match the collapsed vocabulary rubric.
Fixture descriptions should emit exactly one criteria heading after removing the duplicate Success Criteria block.
Gold-set score tallies must remain unchanged after vocabulary-only edits, confirming no semantic expectation moved.
